title: Sign-in
description: A sign-in page with passkey and single sign-on options, an email and password form with inline validation and a password toggle, and a brand panel on wide screens.
summary: Passkey, SSO and email sign-in with validation and a status bar.

remix.name: Poster
remix.description: Neo-brutalist: 2px ink frames, hard offset shadows, pastel fills under black ink and a heavy grotesque display face, in light and dark.

notes: The validation enhancer waits for blur or submit before showing errors, sets aria-invalid, focuses the first invalid field and blocks an invalid submit; the status module then shows the form's data-validation-message in the status bar. Without JavaScript the form submits natively and the server must answer with its own errors.

Nothing is authenticated here. Map server errors (wrong password, locked account) onto the fields with FormValidator.setErrors from actual-css/js/validation, and keep them generic so they do not reveal which accounts exist.

The passkey button and single sign-on link are placeholders: WebAuthn and your identity provider belong to your authentication service. The email field's autocomplete="username webauthn" lets browsers offer passkeys in the autofill list.

The password toggle uses a command invoker handled by the password enhancer; it keeps the label "Show password" and announces the state through aria-pressed. A revealed password reverts to hidden on submit and on page hide.
Keep a single [data-status] status bar per page. The brand panel is a data-theme="dark" island shown from 60rem; it repeats nothing the form needs.
